rules: Generate the items in the order listed: a parent (zoom source), a pair source or a "continues" source always comes before the item that refers to it.
Pass every file in reference_images to the image tool (style-tests/ for ST*.png, ch1/ for A0-*/C-*, cutscenes/refs/ for refs/*, cutscenes/ for the rest).
Items with "pair_of" are the same picture with one change: make them with the image tool's edit mode from the pair_of image, so everything else stays put.
Items with "chroma_window": the window glass must be flat pure green #00FF00, nothing else green in the picture.
Name each output exactly as "file". If you make several variants, add -a, -b, -c before .png.
People only where the prompt says so. No text anywhere: the game writes every word (tags, tickets, signs, the letter, the card, the plate, ROSA, FILED).

shots.motion: the lit train crosses; the camera follows it and closes on one lit window
shots.join: into the window: the window opens into the office

captions.text:
The night service runs between stored places.
The archive calls it the last line.

shots.motion: down the shelves of tagged things to the desk; the lamp sways with the carriage
shots.join: fly into the case on the top shelf

captions.text: Everything left on board comes here, to Lost Property.

shots.motion: slow push onto the tag; the claim number is on it
he turns the tag over: M. VELEZ · BELLWETHER
shots.join: pull back out to the desk

captions.text:
The clerk, Butch, had filed it a hundred times.
He could not leave it alone.

shots.motion: his head drops onto his arms; the lamp burns low; the carriage rocks

captions.text: The line keeps running while someone rides it.

shots.motion: Bellwether slides away behind the glass; the case stays on the rack
shots.join: down to the ticket in his hand

captions.text:
The orchard case stayed on the rack.
Her other ticket did not.

shots.motion: CITY LINE · ONE WAY · 1978; a small tremor of the train
fields scroll into the city; its five signs light one after another like a bell
shots.join: through the glass into the city

captions.text:
The city ahead ran on light
it had borrowed from the train.

shots.motion: CITY TERMINAL lights; Butch steps down; on the far roof a rose scarf turns away and is gone

captions.text:
One roof ahead.
Always one roof ahead.

shots.motion: the train pulls out; the coat corner flaps; the platform lamp slides away
shots.join: through the door window into the carriage

shots.motion: the letter is legible: "Butch — … KEEP MOVING. — M."; the lantern flickers

captions.text:
The letter was a day old.
It read as if she had written it a minute ago.

shots.motion: drawers and pages stream past; light grows at the end of the tunnel
hard sun, dust; the clock reads 14:20; drift right to the ticket board

captions.text:
Echo City keeps the afternoon
its people remember.

shots.motion: SEAT 43 on both tickets

captions.text:
Today it was keeping two tickets
for seat forty-three.

shots.motion: dusk country slides by; sun stripes flicker over the empty seat 43
the colour drains out of the country, leaving pencil lines
shots.join: the paper becomes a sheet on a table

shots.motion: ROSA signed in the corner

captions.text: Rosa Velez drew the orchard every summer.

shots.motion: a grey wash sweeps across; FILED stamps down

captions.text:
The archive kept her drawings, and painted the colour out.
Colour is hard to file.

shots.motion: the train slows into the drawing; one fleck of red blooms at the hedge

captions.text: Under the grey, a hawthorn was still red.

shots.motion: following the train into the dark, the wet colour dries into ink
slow move in; the train stops; smoke hangs
the four cases light one at a time

captions.text: The archive had filed his journey already.

shots.motion: ACC. 1978-0412 · VELEZ, M. · PENDING types itself

captions.text: One object was still pending.

shots.motion: the lamp flickers; the shadow does not move

captions.speaker: THE ARCHIVIST
captions.text: The museum will need one clean answer.

shots.motion: the six lamps go out one by one; the inlay surfaces as rails
the worlds slide in around Butch as Chapter 1 windows: the office, the rooftops, the square, the painted country
slow push down the carriage

captions.speaker: THE CONDUCTOR
captions.text: Tickets, please.

shots.motion: the punch rises

captions.speaker: THE CONDUCTOR
captions.text: The line runs while someone rides it.

captions.speaker: THE CONDUCTOR
captions.text: You are the someone.

shots.motion: Butch lifts his lantern; it flares
each stone glows in turn

captions.text: Five things the archive could not file.

shots.motion: LAST CARRIAGE on the plate; the little window flickers; move in
the black ticket floats above the seat, turning slowly

captions.text: A ticket that is never punched…

shots.motion: he steps in; the door shuts

captions.text: …never ends its journey.

shots.motion: the stacked worlds fold back, window by window, into one carriage

captions.text: The Conductor did not stop the train. Nobody could.

shots.motion: Butch walks the length of the train, lamp in hand; the camera walks with him
slow push on the empty seat

captions.text: One carriage ahead, the seat beside her was empty at last.

shots.motion: he sits down beside her; two lamps pass outside and sweep light across them

captions.text: He did not look for her reflection.

shots.motion: the night service crosses the viaduct from the opening and runs on into the dark
shots.join: end, then the STATUS: OPEN card

captions.text: The night service kept running.
